## What the reporters noticed

_Eight reporters, each on their own beat. They read the articles above and tell you what they see — suggestion with citations, never proof of anyone's motive._

### Hermes — Pushes back

Same event, 3 outlets, 3 different front doors. Here is how each one leads it: Global News opens with "Canada still talking trade with U.S. officials despite no meetings: LeBlanc"; AP News opens with "Why Canada? America’s northern neighbor seems an unlikely target for a trade war"; CTV News opens with "Trump says trade deal with Canada could come ‘fairly soon,’ U.S. has been ‘ripped off’ for 50 years".

I read every version, and they are barely the same story. Global News wants you thinking about "Canada still talking trade with U.S. officials despite no meetings: LeBlanc". AP News wants you thinking about "Why Canada? America’s northern neighbor seems an unlikely target for a trade war". CTV News wants you thinking about "Trump says trade deal with Canada could come ‘fairly soon,’ U.S. has been ‘ripped off’ for". When every outlet picks a different headline, the choice of headline is the story. Read one and you will feel informed. Read them all and you will realize each one buried somebody else's lead.
